description: Source code for the Ethernet driver 'eth_liteeth' for Zephyr RTOS, implementing Ethernet interface functions including initialization, transmission, reception, and IRQ handling.

methods.name: eth_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Ethernet device, calls configuration function.

methods.name: eth_tx
methods.description: Handles transmission of Ethernet packets, manages device readiness and slot switching.

methods.name: eth_rx
methods.description: Handles reception of Ethernet frames, allocates buffer, copies data, and enqueues frame.

methods.name: eth_irq_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for Ethernet IRQ, processes TX and RX events.

methods.name: eth_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes network interface, sets MAC address, and configures slots and events.

methods.name: eth_caps
methods.description: Returns hardware capabilities of the Ethernet device.

methods.name: eth_irq_config
methods.description: Configures IRQ for the Ethernet device.
